head.intro: What every style follows: its product type with the fields it must have and the defaults it starts with, what may change in each state of its life, and how far the fabric used may differ from the estimate.

live.changedBody: Your changes on this page are kept until you read again; saving now is refused because the settings moved on.

scope.label: Whose settings
scope.companyHint: The settings of {company}. Where it keeps no rule of its own, it follows every company’s, then the default.
scope.allHint: The settings every company follows where it keeps none of its own. Where these say nothing, the default applies.

noAccess.title: Product settings are not in your role
noAccess.body: Reading them needs the right to see styles (product.styles.view). An administrator gives it in Admin › Roles & permissions.

card.neverChanged: Never changed here: it follows what is in force above.

loosen.title: Confirm a looser rule
loosen.intro: From the moment you save, more may change in styles in these states:
loosen.reasonHint: Kept with the change in the audit trail.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.saveType: Save the product type (in its window)

rules.title: Edit rules per lifecycle state
rules.description: What may change in a style in each state of its life. Every product write asks the rule of its style’s state.
rules.companyHint: A state set to “Follow every company” takes every company’s rule, and the default where that says nothing.
rules.allHint: A state set to “Default” takes the product module’s own rule: free until approved, a new revision from approved to phase-out, blocked when discontinued.
rules.loosens_one: 1 state lets more through than today: you will be asked why before it is saved.
rules.loosens_other: {count} states let more through than today: you will be asked why before they are saved.

lets.title: What each rule lets through
lets.intro: The same check every product write runs. A released revision never changes: a change goes out with a new one.
lets.withDraft: Yes, while a new revision is open
lets.changeOrder: Only from an approved change order

kindHint.DETAILS: Name, names in other languages, description, season
kindHint.SPEC: Every other field of the style, its colourways and its type
kindHint.NEW_REVISION: Start a revision or copy one into a new draft
kindHint.DRAFT: The BOM, routing and pieces of an open draft

tolerance.title: Consumption tolerance
tolerance.description: How far the material really used at the cutting table may differ from the marker’s estimate.

ruleHint.MATCH: A figure different from the estimate is refused until a note explains it.
ruleHint.MAY_DIFFER: The figure typed is kept as it is.
ruleHint.WARN_ABOVE: The figure is kept; a difference above the percent, more or less, shows a warning.

tolerance.defaultHint: May differ: the figure typed is kept.
tolerance.percentHint: A percent above 0 and at most 100, as 3 or 2,5.

problem.percent: Write a percent above 0 and at most 100, with at most 4 decimals.

tolerance.where: The cutting table reads the rule of the cut order’s material: its kind’s own rule, else the general rule, then every company’s.

costing.title: Costing defaults
costing.description: Cost per minute, planned efficiency and overhead: kept in Finance settings, their one home, and shown here as read.
costing.noRight: Your role does not read the costing values.
costing.noRates: No labour rate is in force yet: a cost sheet counts no labour until Finance sets one.
costing.noGrain: The cost per minute is shown only to roles that see costs.
costing.where: Change them in Finance settings: a change there reaches every cost sheet.
costing.whereNoRight: They are changed in Finance settings, by the accountant or the owner.

types.title: Product types
types.description: Jacket, trousers, suit, gloves, vest: the fields a style of each must have before release and the defaults a new style starts with. A child type inherits its parent’s.

empty.title: No product type yet
empty.body: A type says what a style of it must have and what it starts with. Styles work without one.

emptyArchived.title: No archived type
emptyArchived.body: An archived type stays on the styles that have it; a new style no longer takes it.

types.how: A new style takes its type’s defaults where it leaves a field empty; the release check asks the required fields.

row.archiveHint: Its styles keep it; a new style no longer takes it.

held.noRight: Changing product settings needs the product settings right (product.settings.manage) over this company.
held.noRightAll: Every company’s settings are changed only by a role over every company with product.settings.manage.
held.offline: Offline: your changes are kept on this page until the connection is back.
held.offlineBody: What you see is the last copy read. Saving is held until the connection is back; your changes are kept on this page.
held.noneActive: None of the ticked types is active.
held.noneArchived: None of the ticked types is archived.

type.codeHint: Up to 60 characters, no spaces. Unique.
type.name: Name
type.kindHint: A parent type is of the same kind.
type.whoseHint: A type of every company may be taken by every company’s styles.
type.parentHint: It inherits the parent’s required fields and every default it does not set.
type.requiredHint: The style fields a style of this type must have filled before it is released. A parent’s come on top.
type.defaults: What a new style starts with
type.defaultsHint: A new style of this type takes these where it leaves the field empty. Empty here: the parent’s.
type.label: Garment label template
type.labelNoRight: Picking a label template needs the right to read certificates and labels.
type.archivedBody: Its styles keep it; a new style no longer takes it. Restore it to change it.

held.kindInUse: The kind of garment stays while styles or child types use this type: another kind is a new type.
held.archived: Archived: restore it to change it.

problem.code: Write a code of 1 to 60 characters without spaces.
problem.codeTaken: This code is taken by another type.
problem.name: Write a name of 1 to 200 characters.
problem.standard: A standard is at most 60 characters.
problem.ppeClass: A class is at most 10 characters.
problem.ppeCategory: Pick the PPE category the standard and class go with (here or on the parent).
problem.ppe: This PPE category, standard and class do not go together for this kind of garment (EN 17092 never on gloves; protective gear is at least Category II).
problem.kindInUse: Styles or child types use this type: its kind of garment stays.
problem.parent: This parent cannot be taken: it must be active, of the same kind of garment, of this type’s company or every company, and not one of its children.
problem.required: One of the required fields cannot be required.
problem.scale: This size scale cannot be taken: it must be active and of this type’s company or every company.
problem.label: This label template cannot be taken: it must not be retired and be of this type’s company or every company.
problem.template: This measurement template cannot be taken here.

read.signed_out: You were signed out. Sign in again.
read.forbidden: Your role does not read these settings.
read.not_found: This company is not one you can see.
read.unavailable: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests just now. Wait a moment and try again.
read.contract: The answer was not what this page expects. Reload the page.
read.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.

write.moved: Someone changed this meanwhile: read again, then make your change again.
write.codeTaken: This code is taken by another type.
write.kindInUse: Styles or child types use this type: its kind of garment stays.
write.state: This is not possible in its present state: read again.
write.archived: Archived: restore it first (a type under an archived parent: restore the parent first).
write.invalid: Something is not right: see the fields.
write.forbidden: Your role does not change these settings.
write.forbiddenAll: Every company’s settings are changed only by a role over every company.
write.signed_out: You were signed out. Sign in again; your changes are kept on this page.
write.not_found: It is no longer there: read again.
write.rate_limited: Too many requests just now. Wait a moment and save again.
write.unavailable: The server did not answer: nothing was saved. Try again.
write.internal: Something went wrong on the server: nothing was saved.

problem.typeGone: That product type is not here any more.

done.rulesLoosened: Edit rules saved: the looser rule and its reason are in the audit trail.
done.archived_one: 1 type archived. Its styles keep it.
done.archived_other: {count} types archived. Their styles keep them.
done.archivedSome: {count} of {total} types archived; the others were refused (read the list again).
done.restoredSome: {count} of {total} types restored; the others were refused (a type under an archived parent: restore the parent first).
